screens.name: landing
screens.purpose: Marketing landing page with hero, before/after, style gallery, testimonials, CTA
screens.success_criteria: Hero image visible. Gold CTA button visible. No broken images. No console errors. Smooth scroll animations.

screens.name: auth
screens.purpose: Email+password login and Google OAuth sign-in
screens.success_criteria: Email and password inputs visible. Continue button works. Error messages display on bad credentials. Successful login redirects to step-1.

screens.name: dashboard
screens.purpose: Main hub showing room cards, stats, style profile, new room CTA
screens.success_criteria: User greeting visible. Room cards or empty state displayed. New Room CTA clickable. Nav sidebar works.

screens.name: step-1
screens.purpose: Welcome/intro screen with particle animation. Sets the mood before quiz.
screens.success_criteria: Gold particle canvas animation visible. Welcome text visible. CTA button navigates to step-2. No console errors.

screens.name: step-2
screens.purpose: Room type selection + 3 anchor quiz questions (2x2 image grids). Sets prior for Bayesian quiz.
inputs: click one of 4 style images per question (3 questions)
outputs: computes style prior from anchor picks
screens.success_criteria: Room type cards visible and selectable. 2x2 image grid with 4 style images per question. Images load from Supabase storage. Progress indicator shows 1/2/3 OF 3. Gold border on selected image. Navigate to step-3 after 3 picks.

screens.name: step-3
screens.purpose: Bayesian comparison quiz: 24 side-by-side pairs, non-visual questions, fingerprint computation
inputs: click preferred image in each pair
screens.success_criteria: Two comparison images side by side. Progress counter visible. Images load without broken state. Clicking an image advances to next pair. After 24 pairs, computes fingerprint and navigates to step-3b.

screens.name: step-3b
screens.purpose: Style blend confirmation. Shows computed style percentages and allows adjustment.
screens.success_criteria: Style blend bars with percentages visible. Style names show via display names (not raw COVA* keys). 'This feels right' button present. Confirm navigates to step-4.

screens.name: step-4
screens.purpose: Fingerprint reveal with radar chart, color palette, style tags, and tweak input
screens.success_criteria: Radar chart with 6 dimensions renders. Color palette swatches visible. Style tags shown. Tweak input accepts text. Continue button navigates to step-5.

screens.name: step-5
screens.purpose: Budget tier selection (Essential/Elevated/Refined/Luxe). Swipeable cards.
inputs: swipe or click to select budget tier
screens.success_criteria: 4 budget tier cards visible. Each shows price range and description. Selected tier highlighted in gold. Continue navigates to step-6.

screens.name: step-6
screens.purpose: Room photo capture: desktop upload, QR handoff for mobile, or direct file upload
screens.success_criteria: Upload zone visible. File input accepts images. QR code generates for mobile. Photo preview shown after upload. Room created in DB. Navigate to step-7.

screens.name: step-7
screens.purpose: Pre-detection loading screen. Polls for furniture detection results.
outputs: navigates to step-7b or step-7c when complete
screens.success_criteria: Loading animation with progress bar. Headline text cycles. Detection dots appear on room image. Auto-navigates when detection completes.

screens.name: step-7b
screens.purpose: Constraints/preferences input before redesign
screens.success_criteria: Text input for constraints visible. Continue button works. Constraints parsed and stored.

screens.name: step-7c
screens.purpose: Keep/remove UI for detected furniture items. Shows bounding boxes on room photo.
screens.success_criteria: Room photo visible with colored overlays on detected items. Each item has keep/remove toggle. Remove All toggle present. Item list scrollable. Design My Room button navigates to step-7d.

screens.name: step-7d
screens.purpose: Tabbed chatbot (All/Products/Tech/Art). Personalization before render. Fires redesign pipeline.
screens.success_criteria: 4 tabs visible (All/Products/Tech/Art). Starter chips visible per tab. Chat input works. Design My Room CTA unlocks after completing All + one other tab. Fires redesign and navigates to step-8a.

screens.name: step-8a
screens.purpose: Render reveal with before/after comparison. Polls for redesign completion.
screens.success_criteria: Loading state while render processes (up to 3 min). Render image appears when ready. Before/after slider works. Style tags shown. Continue navigates to step-8b. Error state with Retry if timeout.

screens.name: step-8b
screens.purpose: Refinement options: specific changes, vibe sliders, layout, or direction variants
screens.success_criteria: Render image visible. 4 refinement paths available. Sliders respond. Apply fires re-render. Max 3 refinements enforced. Continue to step-9.

screens.name: step-9
screens.purpose: Shoppable room: product hotspots, category filters, product cards with affiliate links
screens.success_criteria: Redesigned room image visible. Product cards displayed. Category filters work. Sort dropdown works. Shop buttons have affiliate URLs. Save/heart toggles work.

screens.name: profile
screens.purpose: User profile with style fingerprint, email, sign-in method, delete account
screens.success_criteria: Email and sign-in method shown. Style fingerprint data displayed. Retake Quiz link works. Delete account button present.

screens.name: saved
screens.purpose: Saved products library with filters, view modes, budget tracking
screens.success_criteria: Category filter pills visible. Grid/list toggle works. Products display. Quick-view modal opens. Export button works.

screens.name: settings
screens.purpose: User settings: profile edit, style radar, budget prefs, notifications, subscription, privacy
screens.success_criteria: All sections render. Form fields editable. Save buttons work. Radar chart animates. Delete account modal works.

screens.name: room-3d
screens.purpose: 3D room viewer with SparkJS, interactive product hotspots, chat
screens.success_criteria: 3D viewer loads. Hotspot dots visible and clickable. Product panel slides in on click. Chat bubble toggles panel.

screens.name: budget
screens.purpose: Budget calculator with tier tabs and product alternatives
screens.success_criteria: 4 tier tabs visible. Switching tiers updates prices. Product alternatives shown per tier.

screens.name: chatbot
screens.purpose: Standalone chatbot test page with mock conversation
screens.success_criteria: Chat bubble visible. Panel toggles open/close. Mock messages render with product embeds.

screens.name: product-panel
screens.purpose: Product panel component test page with hotspots
screens.success_criteria: Hotspot dots visible. Click opens product panel. Carousel navigates. Similar items shown.

screens.name: capture-room
screens.purpose: Desktop room photo capture with 8-slot grid and QR mode
screens.success_criteria: 8-slot photo grid visible. File upload works. QR code displays. Auto-continues at 4+ photos.

screens.name: capture-mobile
screens.purpose: Mobile QR landing for single-photo capture
screens.success_criteria: Token validates. Camera capture works. Photo uploads. Success message shown.

flows.name: new-user-onboarding
flows.description: Complete new user journey: sign up → style quiz → budget → photo upload → detection → keep/remove → personalization → render → refinement → shopping

flows.name: returning-user-new-room
flows.description: Returning user with existing fingerprint creates a new room

flows.name: quiz-only
flows.description: User completes style quiz without room upload
